descriptionChirho: To engage in literal physical combat or warfare; used of servants who would physically fight to defend (John 18:36).
To compete in an athletic contest, used metaphorically of the disciplined effort required in the Christian life, drawn from the imagery of Greek games (1 Cor 9:25).

To exert great effort in spiritual labor, prayer, or the pursuit of faith; metaphorical extension of combat/athletic language to describe intense spiritual striving (Col 1:29; 4:12; 1 Tim 6:12; 2 Tim 4:7; Luke 13:24; 1 Tim 4:10).
